correctness.rationale: Encode each allocation by y=a+(q-b), a sum of m fair binary indicators, with y layer weight C(m,y). The two WEF1 envy directions reduce to inequalities about x=a-b and entitlement target alpha(p-q), with deletion availability creating explicit excluded boundary sublayers. Independently exhaustively checked 378 (m,p,alpha) combinations of all 2^m allocations (m<=9, seven rational entitlements), confirming the exact count. Stirling and local binomial central limit theorem yield the entropy rate H(alpha*lambda+beta*(1-lambda))-log 2 and critical lattice factor, which are analytical, not extrapolated from tests.
